'''Serrah''' was a [[Seanchan]] ''[[sul'dam]]''.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
== History ==
She aided the [[Ever Victorious Army]] in their occupation of [[Toman Head]], and serves under Lord [[Timak]], stationed in the village of [[Tobin's Hollow]] with her ''[[damane]]'', [[Druu]]. She tests all women to see if they are ''[[marath'damane]]'' by placing an ''[[a'dam]]'' around their neck.<ref name="RPG"/>
